shared_elements: incised/carved marks on a stone surface
justification: A shows a flat, purely linear scheme: a large cross-like framework with a semicircular arc and bands of angular script-like signs running along the margins, entirely abstract and two-dimensional. B shows deeply modelled relief of bulbous, organic heads or beasts with hollowed eye sockets, a hand-like form and a spiral, with no linear framing, script or geometric ordering; the only overlap is the coincidental presence of curved and roughly circular shapes.
